Hi Emma — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps on pricing so we can align with your finance/procurement team: 

1) Volume & current estimate you shared:
- Expected usage: ~2M tokens/day (~60M tokens/month) for first 6 months; growth to ~5M/day by Q4 if pilot succeeds.
- Target budget range you mentioned on the call: $8k–$12k/month initially.

2) Unit economics / target $/1M tokens you mentioned:
- You indicated a target of ~$750–$900 per 1M tokens (goal: keep inference costs predictable for the pilot).

3) Discount paths we discussed:
- Startup program: 20% off list for 12 months (needs company eligibility confirmation). See attached terms.
- Committed-use discounts: tiered discounts for 6–36 month commitments (examples in attached “Proposed-Commitment-Offer.xlsx”).
- Multi-year incentives: additional 5–10% for 2–3 year upfronts or annual prepayment.

4) Ask from Acme to help size the offer: can you confirm
- expected average tokens/day for pilot period (Feb–May)?
- whether you prefer monthly billing versus annual prepay?
- procurement contact for a formal SOW/PO?

Attachments: Redwood-Startup-Program-Terms.pdf (summary of eligibility & benefits), Proposed-Commitment-Offer.xlsx (pricing scenarios — hosted vs dedicated).

If it helps, I can sketch 3 pricing scenarios (no commit, 12-month commit, 24-month commit) and show the $/1M token math for each. I can have that back to you by Wednesday EOD.

Best,

Emma / Tom — thanks, that’s helpful. Quick answers and a preliminary math example below. I’ve also looped Aditya (sales lead) and Marissa (sales ops/finance) to help on commitment sizing & approvals.

1) Startup eligibility: yes, we generally qualify companies pre-Series A for the startup program; we’ll need a cap table summary + latest SAFE/term sheet to confirm. Startup program is 20% off list for 12 months and includes credits for onboarding. See attached.

2) Preliminary pricing math (hosted API, list price assumptions):
- List price example (hosted): $1,200 per 1M tokens (example baseline for similar models).
- Startup program (20%): $960 / 1M tokens.
- Committed-use example (12-month, 1.2B tokens total ~100M/month avg): 30% off list => $840 / 1M tokens.
- 24-month prepay (1.5B+ total): 35% off list => $780 / 1M tokens.

Given your stated target (~$800 / 1M for pilot), the combination of startup program + a modest 12-month commitment gets you close (~$768 / 1M if both applied, subject to eligibility and approval).

3) Multi-year incentives: we can add an extra 5% on top for a 2–3 year committed prepay. That would bring you into the ~$740–$740 / 1M range depending on total token volume and billing cadence.

4) Next steps I propose:
- Laura to send formal one-page pricing scenarios (no commit / 12m commit / 24m prepay) with total monthly $ and $/1M math — I’ll have this by EOD today.
- Emma/Tom to confirm startup eligibility docs and preferred billing cadence (monthly vs annual).
- If procurement needs a formal quote/SOW, we’ll prepare and route for signature (DocuSign link included when ready).

Tom — any procurement constraints we should be aware of (PO terms, net-30 vs net-45, tax)?

Best,
Laura
